# Project Instructions for GitHub Copilot

## Project Overview

Project Name: Procurement ERP

Description: A web application for managing procurement processes efficiently.

## Tech Stack

- Vue.js
- Node.js
- Tailwind CSS
- Pinia

## Coding Standards

- Follow the Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide.
- Write clear and concise comments for complex logic.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Ensure code is modular and reusable.

## Folder Structure

- `src/app`: Main application files
- `src/features`: Feature-specific modules
- `src/components`: Vue components
- `src/assets`: Static assets like images and styles
- `src/utils`: Utility functions

## Best Practices

- Use Pinia for state management.
- Leverage Tailwind CSS for styling and layout.
- Optimize Vue components for performance.
- Use Lucide icons for consistent iconography.
- Use PrimeVue for UI components where applicable.
- Ensure responsive design for all components.
